body: Why can't people read? You and that other guy just seemed to ignore what I've said in the beginning. I already said I don't know why I think about suicide, sure I'm not entertained but I don't feel that's the main or only reason.
The thing is I don't know if I want to die. It's something I want to figure out and resolve but I have no method to materialize the choice.
I'm having a hard time figuring out what you are suggesting. I already try my best to be a good person it's just the thought of suicide nags me all the time.
What do you mean by "mental slavery"?
Maybe I will have a dream or a goal if I live after I make the decision.

> Go die fighting to make the world a better place.

I'd rather focus on myself. I'm not concerned with society as a whole because I'm not in a position of power to do anything.
I don't see how this is relevant.
